_comment: The English name of every book whose own name is Arabic. A reader who cannot type Arabic has no way to reach مختصر القدوري, and the book picker's own placeholder already promises them 'Quduri', so this is what makes that promise true. Display and search both read it.
_why_one_file: These books arrive from three different places: the classical texts from books/openiti-books.json, the Arabic tafsirs from quran/editions.json, and anything added later from wherever it comes. An English name is one idea, so it lives in one file rather than being added to each manifest's own shape. A book missing from here simply has no English name, which the picker shows as it is rather than inventing one.
_spelling: Plain English letters, no academic marks, matching the names the app already writes for itself ('Maqayees al-Lugha', 'Tasheel al-Nahw'). The picker folds spelling differences when it searches, so 'kuduri' and 'Qudoori' both reach the Quduri.
